channel.title: Ring HomePod Doorbell updates
channel.description: Release updates for the self-hosted Ring-to-AirPlay custom chime bridge.

item.title: Ring HomePod Doorbell 0.2.14
item.description: Version 0.2.14 skips AirPlay receivers that currently require authorization, so one unavailable device can no longer prevent playback on ready HomePods.

item.title: Ring HomePod Doorbell 0.2.13
item.description: Version 0.2.13 fixes Ring push notification decryption when Web Push headers contain additional parameters, preventing affected doorbell events from being dropped.

item.title: Ring HomePod Doorbell 0.2.12
item.description: Version 0.2.12 adds the public project website, bilingual marketing content, and support links alongside the existing Ring-to-AirPlay bridge.
